day_plans.assumes: Any day except Tuesday — the Art Institute is closed Tuesdays. If your only day is a Tuesday, open with Willis Tower Skydeck instead and add the Winter Garden at Harold Washington Library. Book the river cruise the night before; it sells out.
day_plans.assumes_zh: 除周二以外的任何一天（芝加哥艺术博物馆周二闭馆）。如果你只有周二，改成上午先去威利斯大厦观景台，并加上哈罗德·华盛顿图书馆的 Winter Garden。建筑游船请提前一晚订票，经常售罄。

stops.name: Art Institute of Chicago
stops.reason: Arrive before the 10am open, shoot the bronze lions, then give two hours to the Impressionist wing — the single highest-value indoor stop in the city.
stops.reason_zh: 赶在10点开门前到，先拍门口两只铜狮，然后用两小时逛印象派展厅——全城性价比最高的室内景点。

stops.name: Cloud Gate ("The Bean")
stops.reason: Straight across the street from the museum, and the crowd underneath is still thin before noon.
stops.reason_zh: 就在博物馆马路对面，正午之前豆子底下的人还不算多。

stops.name: Millennium Park (Crown Fountain / Jay Pritzker Pavilion)
stops.reason: Same park as the Bean — walk five minutes to the LED face towers and the Gehry bandshell.
stops.reason_zh: 和大豆子同一个公园，步行五分钟即到皇冠喷泉的LED人脸塔和盖里设计的露天音乐厅。

stops.name: Goddess and the Baker
stops.reason: One block west at 33 S Wabash — a fast sit-down lunch and the rainbow cake slice without leaving the Loop.
stops.reason_zh: 往西一个街区（33 S Wabash），快速午餐加一块彩虹蛋糕，不用离开 Loop。

stops.name: Chicago Architecture River Cruise (Wendella / CAC First Lady)
stops.reason: Docks are a ten-minute walk north; 75-90 minutes on the water is the best orientation to the whole city you can buy.
stops.reason_zh: 码头往北步行十分钟；75到90分钟的水上讲解，是了解整座城市最划算的方式。

stops.name: Chicago Riverwalk / Urban Kayaks
stops.reason: You are already at river level when the boat lets you off — walk the 1.25 miles back east instead of taking the street.
stops.reason_zh: 下船时人正好在河岸层，沿着1.25英里的河滨步道往东走回去，别走上面的马路。

stops.name: Willis Tower Skydeck
stops.reason: Fifteen minutes southwest on foot; time The Ledge for golden hour and skip the 360 Chicago add-on entirely.
stops.reason_zh: 步行十五分钟到西南边；把玻璃阳台安排在黄昏时段，360观景台的 TILT 加购项目可以完全跳过。

stops.name: Portillo's
stops.reason: River North flagship is a straight walk north — Chicago dog and Italian beef settled in one counter order.
stops.reason_zh: 往北直走即到 River North 旗舰店，一次点单就能同时解决芝加哥热狗和意式牛肉三明治。

stops.name: LH Rooftop, LondonHouse Chicago
stops.reason: Four blocks back toward the bridge; the terrace sits right over the river mouth with the skyline lit.
stops.reason_zh: 往桥的方向走四个街区；露台正对芝加哥河入口，夜景天际线一览无余。

day_plans.assumes: Day 1 must not be a Tuesday (Art Institute closed). Day 2 works any day, but check Pilsen taqueria hours — several close early Sunday. Pilsen is the Pink Line, Chinatown is the Red Line, and West Loop is the Green/Pink Line, so this day is three short train hops, not walking.
day_plans.assumes_zh: 第1天不要安排在周二（艺术博物馆闭馆）。第2天任意一天都可以，但要确认皮尔森塔可店的营业时间，周日部分店关得早。皮尔森走粉线、唐人街走红线、西环走绿线／粉线，这一天是三段短程地铁，不是步行连线。

stops.name: Art Institute of Chicago
stops.reason: Start indoors before the crowds; two hours in the Impressionist wing.
stops.reason_zh: 趁人少先进室内，用两小时看印象派展厅。

stops.name: Cloud Gate ("The Bean")
stops.reason: Across the street from the museum entrance.
stops.reason_zh: 就在博物馆正门对面。

stops.name: Millennium Park (Crown Fountain / Jay Pritzker Pavilion)
stops.reason: Same park — Crown Fountain and the Gehry bandshell are a five-minute walk.
stops.reason_zh: 同一个公园，皇冠喷泉和盖里音乐厅步行五分钟。

stops.name: Goddess and the Baker
stops.reason: One block off the park at 33 S Wabash.
stops.reason_zh: 离公园一个街区，33 S Wabash。

stops.name: Chicago Architecture River Cruise (Wendella / CAC First Lady)
stops.reason: Ten minutes north to the docks; the cruise frames everything you will walk past later.
stops.reason_zh: 往北十分钟到码头；这趟船会把你之后要走过的建筑一次讲清楚。

stops.name: Chicago Riverwalk / Urban Kayaks
stops.reason: Walk the riverfront back east; add a kayak hour if the weather holds.
stops.reason_zh: 沿河岸往东走回去；天气好的话可以加一小时皮划艇。

stops.name: Willis Tower Skydeck
stops.reason: Golden hour on The Ledge, fifteen minutes southwest on foot.
stops.reason_zh: 步行十五分钟到西南边，黄昏时段站上玻璃阳台。

stops.name: Portillo's
stops.reason: River North flagship — hot dog and Italian beef in one stop.
stops.reason_zh: River North 旗舰店，热狗和意式牛肉一次搞定。

stops.name: LH Rooftop, LondonHouse Chicago
stops.reason: Four blocks south, terrace over the river mouth.
stops.reason_zh: 往南四个街区，露台正对河口。

stops.name: Pilsen
stops.reason: Pink Line to 18th St, then walk the 16th and 18th Street mural corridor west while the light is still soft.
stops.reason_zh: 粉线坐到18街，趁光线还柔和时沿16街和18街的壁画走廊向西走。

stops.name: Rubi's Tacos
stops.reason: End the mural walk here — huitlacoche and squash-blossom tacos, counter service, cash-fast.
stops.reason_zh: 壁画路线的终点，玉米黑穗菌和南瓜花塔可，柜台点餐，出餐很快。

stops.name: Quesabirria Jalisco
stops.reason: Two tacos each, not a full order — it is a short walk and the birria ramen is worth splitting.
stops.reason_zh: 每人两个塔可就好，别点整份；离得很近，芝士炖牛肉拉面值得分着尝。

stops.name: Chinatown
stops.reason: Red Line one transfer to Cermak-Chinatown; walk Wentworth Ave south to north.
stops.reason_zh: 红线转一次到 Cermak-Chinatown，沿 Wentworth 大道由南向北走。

stops.name: 88 Marketplace Food Court (Chinatown)
stops.reason: Ten stalls under one roof — roast meats and bubble tea to break up the walk, not a full meal.
stops.reason_zh: 一栋楼里十来个摊位，烧腊配奶茶当中途补给，别吃太饱。

stops.name: Ping Tom Memorial Park
stops.reason: Five minutes west of Wentworth — the pagoda on the boardwalk with the river and skyline behind it.
stops.reason_zh: Wentworth 往西五分钟，木栈道上的中式亭子，背后是河与天际线。

stops.name: Adler Planetarium (north lawn / Solar Terrace)
stops.reason: Red Line to Roosevelt, then east — the north lawn is the unobstructed full-skyline shot, and it is free.
stops.reason_zh: 红线到 Roosevelt 再往东走；北草坪是毫无遮挡的完整天际线机位，而且免费。

stops.name: West Loop
stops.reason: Green or Pink Line back west to Morgan; Randolph and Fulton Market is the evening, not a daytime stop.
stops.reason_zh: 绿线或粉线往西回到 Morgan 站；Randolph 街和 Fulton Market 属于夜晚，不适合白天来。

day_plans.assumes: Day 1 not on a Tuesday (Art Institute closed). Day 3 not on a Monday or Tuesday (Garfield Park Conservatory is closed Mon-Tue). Book Chicago Magic Lounge and the river cruise in advance; both sell out. If your three days include both a Monday and a Tuesday, run Day 3 first on the free weekday and push the Loop day to Wednesday.
day_plans.assumes_zh: 第1天不要安排在周二（艺术博物馆闭馆）；第3天不要安排在周一或周二（加菲尔德公园温室周一、周二闭馆）。魔术酒吧和建筑游船都要提前订，经常售罄。如果三天里同时包含周一和周二，就把第3天的行程提到那个可行的工作日，Loop 那天往后挪到周三。

stops.name: Art Institute of Chicago
stops.reason: Two hours in the Impressionist wing before the midday crowd.
stops.reason_zh: 趁中午人潮之前，用两小时看印象派展厅。

stops.name: Cloud Gate ("The Bean")
stops.reason: Directly across from the museum.
stops.reason_zh: 就在博物馆对面。

stops.name: Millennium Park (Crown Fountain / Jay Pritzker Pavilion)
stops.reason: Crown Fountain and the Gehry bandshell, five minutes on foot.
stops.reason_zh: 皇冠喷泉和盖里露天音乐厅，步行五分钟。

stops.name: Goddess and the Baker
stops.reason: 33 S Wabash, one block west of the park.
stops.reason_zh: 33 S Wabash，公园往西一个街区。

stops.name: Chicago Architecture River Cruise (Wendella / CAC First Lady)
stops.reason: The best orientation purchase of the trip; docks are ten minutes north.
stops.reason_zh: 整趟旅程中最值得花的一笔钱，码头往北十分钟。

stops.name: Chicago Riverwalk / Urban Kayaks
stops.reason: Walk back east at river level rather than on the street.
stops.reason_zh: 沿河岸层往东走回去，别走上面的马路。

stops.name: Willis Tower Skydeck
stops.reason: The Ledge at golden hour, fifteen minutes southwest.
stops.reason_zh: 黄昏时段站上玻璃阳台，往西南走十五分钟。

stops.name: Portillo's
stops.reason: River North flagship, hot dog and Italian beef in one order.
stops.reason_zh: River North 旗舰店，一次点齐热狗和意式牛肉。

stops.name: Cindy's Rooftop (Chicago Athletic Association Hotel)
stops.reason: Back south to the Loop — the terrace looks straight across at the lit Millennium Park you walked through this morning.
stops.reason_zh: 回到 Loop 南侧，露台正对早上走过的千禧公园夜景。

stops.name: Pilsen
stops.reason: Pink Line to 18th St, mural corridor west.
stops.reason_zh: 粉线到18街，沿壁画走廊往西走。

stops.name: Rubi's Tacos
stops.reason: The mural walk ends at the tacos, not the other way around.
stops.reason_zh: 先看壁画再吃塔可，顺序别反。

stops.name: Quesabirria Jalisco
stops.reason: Split an order of birria ramen a short walk away — search the full name or Maps will miss it.
stops.reason_zh: 步行不远，分着点一份芝加哥炖牛肉拉面；搜全名，否则地图找不到。

stops.name: Chinatown
stops.reason: Red Line one transfer; walk Wentworth Ave end to end.
stops.reason_zh: 红线转一次；把 Wentworth 大道从头走到尾。

stops.name: HeungSeng Square (underground food court, formerly Richland Center)
stops.reason: The basement hall behind the back stairwell — Xi'an noodles and dumpling counters most visitors never find.
stops.reason_zh: 后楼梯下去的地下美食广场，西安面食和饺子摊，大多数游客根本找不到。

stops.name: Ping Tom Memorial Park
stops.reason: Five minutes west — pagoda, river, skyline, all in one frame.
stops.reason_zh: 往西五分钟，亭子、河景、天际线同框。

stops.name: Adler Planetarium (north lawn / Solar Terrace)
stops.reason: Red Line to Roosevelt then east; free, unobstructed, and the best skyline shot in the city.
stops.reason_zh: 红线到 Roosevelt 再往东；免费、无遮挡，全城最好的天际线机位。

stops.name: West Loop
stops.reason: Green or Pink Line to Morgan — Randolph and Fulton Market carry the whole evening.
stops.reason_zh: 绿线或粉线到 Morgan 站，Randolph 街和 Fulton Market 撑起一整晚。

stops.name: Do-Rite Donuts
stops.reason: West Loop flagship, on the way to the Green Line heading west.
stops.reason_zh: 西环旗舰店，正好在往西坐绿线的路上。

stops.name: Garfield Park Conservatory
stops.reason: Green Line straight west; two acres under glass, free, and almost no tourists get this far west.
stops.reason_zh: 绿线一路往西；两英亩的玻璃温室，免费，几乎没有游客会走这么远。

stops.name: Logan Square
stops.reason: Back east and onto the Blue Line — the Milwaukee Ave strip is a walkable crawl, not a single destination.
stops.reason_zh: 往东折返换蓝线；Milwaukee 大道是一条可以慢慢逛的街，不是单个景点。

stops.name: La Boulangerie & Co
stops.reason: On the same strip — one crookie between two people, ratings on it are genuinely mixed.
stops.reason_zh: 就在同一条街上；两人分一个可颂饼干即可，这家的评分其实有分歧。

stops.name: South Pond Bridge, Lincoln Park
stops.reason: East to Lincoln Park; the wooden bridge gives the skyline reflected in the pond, and the zoo next door is free.
stops.reason_zh: 往东进林肯公园；木桥上能拍到塘中倒影的天际线，隔壁动物园还免费。

stops.name: Pequod's Pizza
stops.reason: Ten minutes west in the same neighborhood — the caramelized crust edge is the deep dish worth the calories.
stops.reason_zh: 同区往西十分钟；焦糖化的芝士脆边，是唯一值得这些卡路里的深盘披萨。

stops.name: Chicago Magic Lounge
stops.reason: North to Andersonville; enter through the laundromat front, and book weeks ahead.
stops.reason_zh: 往北到安德森维尔；从洗衣房的门进去，务必提前几周订位。

skip_list.name: Navy Pier
skip_list.reason: 4.0 across 15,000+ reviews is respectable, not exceptional, and recent visitors say there is little to do beyond walking and eating chain food — the Ferris wheel photo takes an hour, not the half-day every guide budgets.
skip_list.reason_zh: 一万五千多条评价平均4.0分，只能算及格而非出色，近期评价普遍说除了散步和吃连锁餐饮没什么可做；摩天轮那张照片一小时就够，不值得像各种攻略说的排半天。

skip_list.name: 360 CHICAGO (John Hancock Center observation deck) + TILT
skip_list.reason: You are paying an add-on on top of general admission for a ride multiple reviewers clock at about 90 seconds against an advertised three minutes; if you want one deck, Willis Tower Skydeck is the better single purchase.
skip_list.reason_zh: 在普通门票之外还要另加钱，而多位游客实测这个倾斜体验只有约90秒，官方却宣传三分钟；如果只上一个观景台，威利斯大厦更划算。

skip_list.name: Museum of Ice Cream Chicago
skip_list.reason: $24-30 per adult for candy-colored photo rooms, and the review thread splits hard between delight and 'overrated for the price' — it is a photo set, not a museum.
skip_list.reason_zh: 成人票24至30美元，换来的是几间糖果色拍照房，评价明显两极，'价格虚高'的抱怨反复出现——它是布景，不是博物馆。

skip_list.name: Tetto
skip_list.reason: Open May through October only, so it fails as a year-round recommendation, and 3.7 on Google across 111 reviews with repeated service complaints is below the bar for a hyped rooftop.
skip_list.reason_zh: 只在5月到10月营业，根本谈不上全年推荐；谷歌111条评价3.7分，服务问题被反复提及，对一个被吹得很火的屋顶酒吧来说不合格。

skip_list.name: Indiana Dunes National Park (skyline mirage from the beach)
skip_list.reason: The floating-skyline mirage needs a temperature inversion that happens a handful of days a year, and you pay $25 per vehicle to drive 30-50 miles for a phenomenon no trip can guarantee.
skip_list.reason_zh: 天际线悬浮的海市蜃楼需要特定的逆温条件，一年只出现有限几天；却要开车三十到五十英里、每车缴25美元门票，去赌一个无法保证的景象。

skip_list.name: Frato's Culinary Kitchen (Frato's Pizza)
skip_list.reason: Schaumburg is a 45-60 minute drive each way for a 4.1-rated suburban restaurant, and the 13-inch mozzarella stick that drives the hype is served Sundays only.
skip_list.reason_zh: Schaumburg 单程要开45到60分钟，只为一家评分4.1的郊区餐厅，而带火它的那根13英寸马苏里拉芝士条还只在周日供应。
